title: Weekend Yard Sale Table Mapper
description: A two-prompt Gemini Flash source run producing a self-contained yard-sale table mapper for adding, editing, zoning, and printing priced sale items with a revenue estimate.
model_settings: Gemini web UI mode picker visible as Flash before and after the prompts; default normal Gemini settings, no uploads or extra tools selected.

final_artifact_clue: Final self-contained Yard Sale Table Mapper HTML with item name/price/box/zone fields, edit/update mode, left/center/right table zones, item deletion, total item count, estimated revenue, and print stylesheet.

artifact_versions.notes: Initial Gemini artifact. It rendered as a usable table mapper with add/delete, table zones, print control, and total value, but lacked edit behavior for existing items, justifying prompt 2.
Revised Gemini artifact from prompt 2 adding item edit/update flow for name, price, box, and zone.
Final production-servable alias for the step 2 artifact.

verification_notes: Verified the saved final artifact over local HTTP. It rendered nonblank with the expected add/edit form, left/center/right table layout, total item count, estimated value, and Print Table Map control. Added a vase item at $12.50 in Box 2 to the left zone, edited it to Vintage Vase at $15.00 in Box 7 and moved it to the right zone, then confirmed the item moved zones, box text updated, total stayed at 1 item, estimated value updated to $15.00, and delete removed the item/reset totals. Final artifact includes viewport meta, responsive grid CSS, @media print rules, and no external script/font/image URLs. Narrow/mobile check was limited to responsive CSS/source inspection plus desktop no-overflow checks because Chrome viewport resizing was not exposed in this lane.
result_content: Weekend yard-sale table mapper that lets a seller add, edit, zone, price, print, and total items in one browser file.
